Mizuki belonged to the **Hashimoto Clan**, a criminal clan in Japan. The clan took him in as a child, and at age nine he inherited his father's debt to it.

The sources I found don't say outright who his "guardian" was. The closest match is **Shion**, the Hashimoto figure who raised and trained him. The "Facing Demons" comic covers his past under her. She trained him as a weapon and had him carry out the clan's bidding for years, until he rejected her control.

If you meant a mentor rather than a guardian, that was **Toshiro Yamagami**. He was a captured weaponsmith famed for crafting anima weaponry, and he gave Mizuki hope that curses can be broken.

My information comes from Blizzard's hero page and secondary coverage of the comics, not the comics themselves. The coverage also disagrees on Mizuki's pronouns, and I couldn't check whether newer content changes any of this.

On 14 October 2025, the Season 19 launch patch **reduced Mauga's Cage Fight ultimate cost by 6%**. Blizzard's stated reason was that the ultimate is strong but charges a bit slowly. The cut lets Mauga earn it more often.

The search results also say the same patch buffed Mauga's Combat Fuel major perk. Maximum overhealth went from 100 to 150, and overhealth from critical hits went from 2 to 3. I got this from search summaries and didn't read the patch notes directly, so check the official notes if the exact numbers matter.

Don't confuse this with earlier Cage Fight changes. The 25 March 2025 hotfix raised the ultimate cost by 8% and cut barrier health from 1500 to 1200. The January 9 midseason update removed infinite ammo inside the cage. Those aren't part of the October 14 patch.
